schema.label: Footer menu
schema.help: Create and arrange menus under Blog → Menus.

css: .tb-column-footer{background:var(--tb-color-secondary);color:var(--tb-color-background)}.tb-column-footer__inner{max-width:var(--tb-footer-width);margin:auto;padding:56px 24px 28px}.tb-column-footer__top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,.8fr) minmax(0,1.5fr);gap:48px;padding-bottom:38px}.tb-column-footer__heading{margin:0 0 12px;color:inherit;font-size:26px}.tb-column-footer__text{margin:0;max-width:420px;color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 72%,transparent);line-height:1.65}.tb-column-footer__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--tb-footer-columns),minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.tb-column-footer__link-card{padding:16px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 18%,transparent);border-radius:12px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.tb-column-footer__link-title{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;opacity:.65;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em}.tb-column-footer__link-text{display:block}.tb-column-footer__copyright{margin:0;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 20%,transparent);font-size:13px;opacity:.7}@media(max-width:760px){.tb-column-footer__top{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tb-column-footer__grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(max-width:480px){.tb-column-footer__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.tb-column-footer__menu-group{min-width:0}.tb-column-footer__menu-group>.tb-column-footer__link-title{display:block;margin-bottom:10px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800}.tb-column-footer__menu-children{display:grid;gap:7px}.tb-column-footer__menu-children .tb-column-footer__link-card{padding:8px 0;border:0;border-radius:0;opacity:.78}.tb-menu-empty{color:inherit;opacity:.65}
name: Multi-column Footer
description: A multi-column footer that turns saved menu hierarchy into link groups.

menu_sources.empty_preview: Select a menu in block settings
